items.text: Nico Collins is good to go.
items.why: Full practice Friday; not on final injury report after hamstring.
items.implication: Plug Collins back in as WR1 vs Cowboys secondary.
items.opportunity: Full role return boosts Stroud efficiency and red-zone upside.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Remove Smith from lineups; PHI WR targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Potential bumps for other Eagles pass-catchers including Dontayvion Wicks.

items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.why: McVay: looked sharp, no designation, good to go (possible snap count).
items.implication: Start Nacua as WR1 despite potential workload management; Adams volume may dip.
items.opportunity: Return to 11-personnel and primary target role after missing two games (hip/groin).

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.implication: Sit Jefferson; look to Addison and other Vikings pass-catchers for elevated targets.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for Jordan Addison and remaining MIN WRs.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday’s game vs. the Bears.
items.implication: Sit Hall; Jets RB committee shifts heavily.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full RB snaps for backups after Hall exit last week.

items.text: Kyle Shanahan said WR Mike Evans, who is dealing with a rib injury, will be a game-time decision.
items.implication: Monitor closely; have pivot ready. Kittle volume could rise if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, elevated TE and other WR roles.

items.text: Jeremiah Love in on the Week 4 LOVE list. RB5 in utilization last week with 26 touches (more than W1+W2 combined). Giants allow 5.1 YPC (3rd-most); double-digit target share every game.
items.why: Explosive utilization jump + soft run D + receiving involvement.
items.implication: Must-start RB2 upside in favorable spot.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
items.implication: Start Jackson confidently; full dual-threat upside.

items.text: Terry McLaurin added to the list with a hamstring issue. Was limited today.
items.why: Late Friday hamstring add; limited practice. London game early.
items.implication: High risk; have backup ready. Diggs/Williams could see more if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Stefon Diggs and Antonio Williams target spikes.

items.text: Only a 4-game sample. But with Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share. With Sampson healthy for most of 2025, Judkins was at 8.3%. Judkins now on pace to catch 64 passes. He caught 26 in 14 games played last year.
items.why: Elevated target share without Sampson; receiving pace jump.
items.implication: Judkins more three-down viable and PPR upside ROS.
items.opportunity: 13.8% target share + RB role with teammate absence.

items.text: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels officially is out Sunday.
items.implication: Sit Daniels; Mariota streaming candidate but limited ceiling.
items.opportunity: WR targets (McLaurin/Diggs) still viable but lower floor without Daniels mobility.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on the LOVE list as a top 10 play this week. Led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches. Dowdle out again. Cleveland allows 88+ yards to a RB every game.
items.why: Workhorse usage with Dowdle OUT; soft run matchup on short week.
items.implication: Strong RB2/WR1 flex start with clear path to volume.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price through first month in NFL: 1. Lost goal-line (and some base) work to Emmanuel Wilson 2. Lost pass-down work to George Holani 3. Lost fumbles in back-to-back games 4. Is hurt (chest) 5. Zach Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. That said, Price passes eye test and has run well when given chances. Far, far, far from over for Price longer-term. Projections updated for Price (chest).
items.why: Role erosion + chest injury + Charbonnet returning to practice.
items.implication: Short-term caution; hold for long-term talent.
items.opportunity: Eye-test positive when featured; monitor Charbonnet ramp.

items.text: Sadly, Omarion Hampton is on the Week 4 Hate List. RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate dropped to 42% W3, only 13% third downs. Seattle allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
